tagline: Neighborhood-centered civic hub for White Plains, NY.
mission: WPCNA brings neighborhood associations together, shares civic information across the city, and helps residents stay connected to public life in White Plains.
purpose: White Plains has neighborhood concerns, public meetings, local events, workshop materials, and city notices moving at the same time. This site keeps the most useful pieces together in one place with a neighborhood-centered lens.
useItFor: Use it to keep up with what is coming up, open a neighborhood profile, review agendas and minutes, and find the White Plains pages residents need again and again.
meetingNote: WPCNA usually meets on the second Tuesday of the month at 7:00 p.m. Meetings are held in person at the White Plains Board of Education building (5 Homeside Lane) or online via Zoom, depending on the agenda. Format and timing can shift month to month, so check the latest agenda before you go.

aboutMissionQuote: “The White Plains Council of Neighborhood Associations coordinates the neighborhood associations in White Plains, NY. Its purpose is to enhance the quality of life in the City, and in particular, in its neighborhoods. As an advisory council, the WPCNA functions by disseminating information and opinion to the public and public officials, and by encouraging local action.”
aboutWhatIntro: WPCNA is a forum for neighborhood associations across White Plains. Its role is practical: keep information moving, help associations stay connected, and support local action when neighborhood concerns need attention.

aboutWhatCards.title: Share information
aboutWhatCards.body: WPCNA helps circulate neighborhood concerns, meeting information, civic updates, and public-interest items that residents may otherwise have to find across several different sources.

aboutWhatCards.title: Connect associations
aboutWhatCards.body: The council gives neighborhood associations a place to exchange ideas, compare concerns, and learn from one another.

aboutWhatCards.title: Encourage local action
aboutWhatCards.body: When issues affect neighborhoods, WPCNA helps residents stay organized, informed, and connected to the right public process.

aboutHelpBody:
This site brings together the most useful WPCNA and community information in one place.

The goal is simple: make it easier for residents to see what is happening, understand where it fits, and find the right next step.
aboutHelpList: CNA workshop materials for forming or strengthening a neighborhood association
aboutGovernanceBody: WPCNA’s by-laws and committee work help give the council structure. They support regular communication among neighborhood associations, provide a way to track issues, and help organize discussion around citywide topics.
handbookIntroBody:
WPCNA supports residents who want to build stronger neighborhood organizations in White Plains. This handbook grows out of last year's workshop and is meant to be a practical guide for people who are starting fresh, reviving an older association, or figuring out what organized neighborhood work looks like in real life.

The material below walks through the basics: building a contact list, setting a regular meeting rhythm, working with the City, and staying connected to other neighborhood groups through WPCNA.

handbookResources.title: Workshop guide and slides
handbookResources.description: Full presentation deck from the March 11, 2025 workshop, covering organizing basics, sample agendas, and practical templates.

handbookResources.title: Workshop flyer
handbookResources.description: The original flyer with the workshop date, location, and agenda.

handbookUseBody: If you are thinking about starting a neighborhood association, this is a good first resource. Use it to get oriented, then reach out to WPCNA if you want help talking through the next step, finding out how other associations are organized, or getting connected to the wider council.
homeNeighborhoodsIntro: Explore the neighborhood associations currently represented in WPCNA. Use the map for citywide context, then open an association profile to learn more.
homeEventsIntro: A curated selection of public meetings, arts events, downtown happenings, and neighborhood programs.
homeUsefulIntro: Helpful pages for following meetings, sharing updates, and getting oriented around White Plains.
